result.title: Palmprint Decomposer: Interpretable and Editable Factorization via Synthetic Learning and Instance-Wise Refinement
result.summary: Palmprint recognition and synthesis methods focus on extracting discriminative textures or generating images with varied textures and appearances. However, they do not generally provide an explicit image-level representation that separates palmprint texture from its underlying base appearance for independent analysis or controlled editing. We introduce Palmprint Decomposer, an interpretable framework that represents a palmprint through independently editable factors and reconstructs the image through a multiplicative composition model. A color map and a light map characterize the base appearance, while a structure map and a global texture strength parameter describe texture modulation. However, accurate reconstruction alone does not guarantee separation of palmprint texture from base appearance, as fine palmprint textures may leak into the estimated base appearance. To mitigate this ambiguity, we train the decomposer exclusively on synthetic data with direct factor supervision, using asymmetric decoding paths and decomposition constraints to suppress texture leakage. Instance-Wise Refinement further improves real-image reconstruction by directly optimizing the predicted factors for each input without relying on the trained network. Experiments across seven datasets demonstrate high reconstruction fidelity, with the extracted structure maps generally achieving verification performance comparable to the original images. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves better factor separation while preserving more discriminative palmprint texture information.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Palmprint Decomposer，用颜色图、光照图、结构图与全局纹理强度以乘性组合表示掌纹图像，仅在合成数据上做因子监督训练，并配合实例级细化在测试时直接优化各因子，实现纹理与基础外观的可解释、可编辑分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 其非对称解码路径与分解约束用于抑制细纹理泄漏进基础外观，可能为 LVR 中防止视觉细节坍缩或被旁路吸收提供约束设计线索；实例级 test-time 因子优化也值得核查能否迁移为推理期状态细化。
